headline: Apple Reports Record Q4 Revenue with Surge in India
summary: Apple recorded $114.5 billion in fourth-quarter revenue, driven by exceptional growth in India led by iPhone and Mac sales.
why: Apple Inc. is a dominant global consumer electronics manufacturer whose quarterly results and emerging market penetration heavily influence major stock indices.

impacts.name: Apple
impacts.why: Record quarterly revenue and strong emerging market sales drive positive equity valuation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Strong revenue outperformance and robust expansion in high-potential markets like India exceed expectations, prompting institutional buying.
